non_blocking_notes: Memory management: _admissions, _pending_result_ids, and _completed_result_ids dictionaries/sets grow with admission count but remain bounded by MAX_ADMISSIONS_PER_SCOPE constraint per scope.
JSON canonical form uses ensure_ascii=False to preserve UTF-8; appropriate for untrusted international data.
SHA256 hexdigest stored in Evidence for integrity verification; sufficient for this use case.
result.reasoning_summary: Commit ed8b0a915b9ff8f1a3c85507066595afd79b171d implements FW-MCP-03 bounded untrusted MCP result envelopes with comprehensive security controls. MCPToolResultEnvelope is an immutable frozen dataclass marked UNTRUSTED_DATA, DRY_RUN mode, ENVELOPE_ONLY action. The wrap_result() method enforces exact admission binding (identity check), single-use completion (pending/completed tracking prevents replay and concurrent double-completion), post-admission revocation (reconstructs grant and validates against revoked set), and bounded validation: max depth 8, collection items 128, string bytes 4096, total bytes 64KB, with cycle detection and non-finite rejection. Canonical JSON serialization (sorted keys, consistent separators) enables deterministic hashing. Evidence audit records hash/size/metadata only—never interprets or logs payload content. Rollback on Evidence write failure preserves single-use invariant. Reentrancy safety via RLock and state machine prevents nested calls from double-completing the same admission. No tool execution, interpretation, credentials, filesystem, shell, transport, or deployment authority present. Test suite (7 new tests, 130 total passing) validates immutability, canonicalization, exact admission, single-use, revocation, reentrancy, and all bounds. Deterministic: SHA256 output, no environment/RNG dependencies. Patch is narrow, focused, and has no security gaps against stated requirements.
